releaseNotes:
﻿## Meals
- Meal plan week range is now set under Meals → Settings (start day + days shown), separate from the weekly room schedule
- Prev/Next on the meal plan always moves one calendar week so Sunday–Sunday stays Sunday–Sunday (no more Mon–Mon drift)
- + Cook lets you fill cooks for every meal and save once

## Conferences & calendar
- Guest rooms held for a conference without overnight participants show grey ("Room held") on arrival/departure days instead of blank family green
- Conference guest-room selection lives in Room availability (book all / clear); separate room checklist removed

## Inbox
- Reply composer sits at the top of the email thread

## Fixes
- Conference room stay conflict checks cover room-availability selection more reliably
